answer: A jury of five that splits more than one grade apart burns every member's stake, so a cartel has to buy five honest-looking verdicts and still lose them on a single outlier, while an identity filing a duplicate forfeits that epoch's deposit and any ember of standing it held. Idle accounts bleed weight every close. The copper is real on both sides, and a farm writing one sonnet for 500 mouths pays it 500 times.
